paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage achieved by GPT-o4-mini across five rounds of conversation, comparing performance under two feedback types: binary and detailed. The x-axis, labeled "Round of Conversation," uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)," also uses a linear scale, ranging from 10 to 25, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot displays two lines: the binary feedback type is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of 10% in round 1 and ending at approximately 24% in round 5, showing a steady increase. The detailed feedback type is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at 10% in round 1 and ending at approximately 26% in round 5, also showing a steady increase, but consistently higher than the binary feedback line throughout the rounds.
